tei:div.tei:p: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig las/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyun khyer 'od gsal snang ba bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru badzra dhā ra ye/

rdau rje rnam par 'joms pa bla med lugs kyi bskyed bzlas snying por dril te nyams su len par 'dod pas/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: mtha' klas srid pa'i khams rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi: lan gsum/ gnas yo mchod pa byin rlabs dgos na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas bya/ dngos gzhi lha skur bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das gdod nas rnam dag klong : phyi snod rdo rje'i gur khang rgya che bar: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus thabs shes pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng : sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: 'od zer 'phro 'dus sras bcas rgyal kun gyi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs dpal yon kun: dbang du bsdus thim skad cig dran rdzogs su: bcom ldan gsang bdag rdo rje rnam par 'joms: sku mdog ljang sngon khro 'dzum mtshan dpe'i zhal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten skyil krung bzhugs: sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: spyi bor rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems: sku mdog dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: slar yang ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mo yis: phyogs dus rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus nas: mi phyed rdo rje'i lus su byin brlabs shing : thugs srog sa bon hūm̐ gi sprin 'phros pas: phyogs bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus: shar du rdo rje gtum po sku mdog dkar: lho ru rdo rje be con gser gyi mdangs: nub tu rdo rje tho ba sku mdog dmar: byang du rdo rje phur bu mar gad mdog: thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams: dar sngon stod g.yogs stag lpags sham thabs dang :

sbrul gyi rgyan spras pad nyi'i gdan la bzhengs: de yi phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i klong : rang byung ye shes sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcu: mthing nag phyag gnyis rdo rje phur bu 'dril: khro bo'i chas rdzogs me dpung dbus na rol: sgo bzhir sgo skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang: rdo rje'i pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs: chos srung dam can rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs: gzhan yang rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams tshogs: snang stong zung 'jug chen por gsal ba yi: gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: de las 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: dag pa rab 'byams chos sku'i pho brang nas: longs spyod yongs rdzogs rdo rje rnam par 'joms: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro don bsgrub slad du: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: 'du 'bral spangs pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi: kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: a ti pū hoḥpra tītstsha hoḥ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda sarba pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: gdod nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i ye shes las: rnam kun mchog ldan mtshan dpe'i rol pa can: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag: rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi: nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang kun zhi zhing : tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang bcu'i yon tan sogs: bcom ldan khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs: gsung sngags kyi bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gis: bskor ba'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mchod: byin rlabs dngos grub tshur 'dus bdag nyid la: thim pas grib dang mi gtsang sgrib gnyis sbyangs:

na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya: hu lu hu lu: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha: bhāndha bhāndha: ha na ha na: a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyid gtso bor bzla/ spro zhing nus na rdo rje rnam 'joms gzungs mdo bklag cing grangs bsags/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang yig brgya bzla/ thugs nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni/ ho: snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ye shes lha: zung 'jug mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su gshegs: rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dam tshig pa: 'od gsal smon pa med pa'i klong du thim: a a a: oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang snang ba'i rang bzhin gdan gsum lha: sgrar grags rlung gi 'khor lo yi ge'i sprin: rtog pa rtog med rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang: dus gsum dus med chen por rtag tu spyod: bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs dang shis brjod bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rang nyid la nyer mkho'i ched maṅga las gter gzhung rtsa ba las khol du phyung ste mtshams sbyor cung zad kyis brgyan pa dge legs 'phel// //
